research_status: COMPLETE — all 24 episodes of Akame ga Kill! classified canon/filler/mixed. Corrected 2026-08-26: episodes 20-24 were originally recorded as filler under the same policy applied to FMA 2003's analogous anime-original ending, but Andreas reviewed and confirmed this show's case should map to canon instead, consistent with how 'anime canon' is treated everywhere else in this project. citation_sources.description: QuoteTheAnime's Akame ga Kill! filler list — episodes 1-18 manga canon, episode 19 mixed, episodes 20-24 the anime's own original ending.

epicdope.com's Akame ga Kill! filler guide — independently confirms the identical 1-18/19/20-24 breakdown, and explicitly compares the anime-original ending to how Fullmetal Alchemist (2003) handled its own finale once the anime caught up to the manga.

episodes.status_note: Corrected 2026-08-26: originally recorded as filler here, following the same policy already applied to Fullmetal Alchemist (2003) and Ao no Exorcist's anime-original endings (both sources' own commentary explicitly compared this episode range to FMA 2003's situation). Andreas reviewed and confirmed this show's 'anime canon' framing should map to plain canon instead, consistent with how every other 'anime canon' label in this project is treated (Dragon Ball Super, Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Noragami, and this same show's own Toaru Kagaku no Railgun batch-mate) — this episode range is treated as inserted/side content within the anime's own continuation, not literally replacing where the manga's ending was headed the way FMA 2003's back half does.
